method: Exact rational refinement of a nine-point Gram-defect certificate
summary: Refines R. Arun Chandru's accepted master-of-puppets4 nine-point Gram-defect proof. The single upload file contains the complete refined certificate and counting bridge together with the three fixed website theorem declarations.
